description:
Register a WhatsApp message to the account owner's own phone at a later time:
        once (`at`), every `every_s` seconds, or on a `cron` schedule (give exactly one).
        You cannot send it later yourself; tell the human the registered local time this
        returns. A scheduled message usually arrives outside the 24h window, so it is
        sent as a template and counts toward the monthly quota. The human can list and
        cancel from WhatsApp too: `schedules`, `cancel <name>`.

at.description: One time: ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-11-14T09:00:00+01:00. Without an offset it is read in `timezone`. Must be in the future.
at.title: At

buttons.description: Optional reply options (up to 3); the answer arrives later via `check_replies`. Nobody waits for it.
buttons.title: Buttons

cron.description: Repeat on a 5-field cron expression (minute hour day month weekday), read in `timezone`, e.g. "0 9 * * 1-5" = 09:00 on weekdays. Runs at least 15 minutes apart.
cron.title: Cron

every_s.description: Repeat every N seconds (at least 900, i.e. 15 minutes).
every_s.title: Every S

name.description: Short name (letters, digits, . _ -; up to 40) the human can cancel it by from WhatsApp; default schedule-N.
name.title: Name

text.description: The message to send at each run (1-1024 characters), to the key owner's phone.
text.title: Text

timezone.description: IANA timezone, e.g. "Europe/Warsaw". Default: the phone country's zone (UTC when the country has several). Pass the human's zone when you know it.
timezone.title: Timezone

name: schedule
